sections.text:
[Effects]
Reduces physical and magic damage taken by L.
Increases status ailment resistance by XL.
Damage reduction scales with the number of Hat type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Hat type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
